Hey! I wanted to send over the vision for the website.

The goal is to build a national brand website for SHATTER HOUSE that can support multiple locations and future franchise growth.

Main Website:
https://shatterhouseusa.example

For the visual direction, use a clean, modern, mobile-friendly design with simplicity similar to RageWorks USA. The branding should combine black, purple, and white with large images, generous spacing, and easy navigation.

Homepage Sections:

Hero Banner
Location Selector
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
Reviews
FAQ
Contact

The homepage should immediately show visitors what we offer and allow them to select their location.

Current Locations:

Linden Falls
Port Averly
Ridgehaven

Give every location its own dedicated page while keeping the design and branding consistent across all locations. The website should be built so future locations can be added easily without redesigning the site.

Future examples:

Mesa Crest
Highpoint
Riverbend
Franchise Locations

The overall feel should be a national entertainment brand, not a local business website.

WE USE WIX bookings

historical_evidence_messages.text: Yes, that's a problem—every location needs separate payouts. Would we have to create two wix websites, one for the Shatter House MASTER and one for Ridgehaven directly, so it runs separately, and then also connect to Harbor Valley Shatter House on its own wix account so each is controlled and tracked separately?

historical_evidence_messages.speaker: freelancer
historical_evidence_messages.text: That approach will work. We’ll use https://shatterhouse.example as the master website where visitors can learn about your brand and choose a location. Each location will therefore have its own Wix account, bookings, calendar, reporting, and payment setup, while everything remains connected through the main https://shatterhouse.example website.

historical_evidence_messages.text:
To move the existing domain without deleting the old website, follow these steps:

Step 1 — Prepare the account
Open your Wix account, go to My Sites, and locate the new website.

Step 2 — Reassign the domain
1. Open the Dashboard for the new website.
2. Navigate to Settings → Domains.
3. Choose Connect Existing Domain (or Assign Domain).
4. Select the domain currently connected to the old website.
5. Confirm that the domain should be moved to the new website.

Step 3 — Choose the primary domain
If you are prompted, make the moved domain the Primary Domain.

Step 4 — Allow time for the change
The domain normally starts working within a few minutes, although some cases can take up to 48 hours.

Important
The old website will not be deleted; it will simply lose its connection to the domain. Once the reassignment is complete, visitors using that domain will see the new website as the live site.
